name: Golang Generic
author: stacloud.dev@gmail.com
description: Golang Generic Egg cho STACloud, giu ban mac dinh cu va bo sung cac ban Go stable moi de tai va build ung dung Go thanh file thuc thi.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# golang generic package
set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server
export GOPATH=/mnt/server/go
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin:${GOPATH}/bin
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GO_PACKAGE}" ]; then
    echo "GO_PACKAGE is blank. Skipping Go install so uploaded files can be used."
    exit 0
fi

EXECUTABLE="${EXECUTABLE:-app}"

go env -w GOPATH="${GOPATH}"

if echo "${GO_PACKAGE}" | grep -q '@'; then
    GO_INSTALL_TARGET="${GO_PACKAGE}"
else
    GO_INSTALL_TARGET="${GO_PACKAGE}@latest"
fi

go install "${GO_INSTALL_TARGET}"

PACKAGE_NAME=$(basename "${GO_PACKAGE%%@*}")
if [ -f "${GOPATH}/bin/${EXECUTABLE}" ]; then
    cp -f "${GOPATH}/bin/${EXECUTABLE}" /mnt/server/
elif [ -f "${GOPATH}/bin/${PACKAGE_NAME}" ]; then
    cp -f "${GOPATH}/bin/${PACKAGE_NAME}" "/mnt/server/${EXECUTABLE}"
else
    echo "Unable to locate built executable in ${GOPATH}/bin"
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x "/mnt/server/${EXECUTABLE}"
